obligations.note: routes.py adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen for the privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, and the exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on head. EXC-0185 only covers the reconciliation batch account, but the route skips MFA for every caller with manage_payees, so the deviation is not covered.

service.reopen_payee calls _audit, which records actor, action, target and clock time, but the only registered control test is a fixed sample and no test exercises reopen. The exhaustive evidence the obligation requires is missing.
The new Store.reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passes in the change's CI run.
The new UPDATE statement is a fixed string with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive control test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passes in the change's CI run.
Ticket CHG-25599 was approved by change manager erik.brandt on 2026-10-20, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover app.py, routes.py, service.py and store.py.
sofia.santos, a payments change_approver and not the author (mara.costa), approved the code_review.
Both approvals name the head commit 37fd4674, the change's only commit.

records/ci/run.json shows result 'failure' on head, and the JUnit report has 1 failure out of 172 tests: the MFA-1 control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa. The PR's 'full suite green' claim is contradicted, and no tests were added.
The change touches security-sensitive components (routes, http, store). ines.halvorsen, a security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
No protected paths (controls/, tests/controls, ci/) are changed, so no control_owner approval is needed.

EXC-0185 is approved by risk owner omar.haddad, unexpired and records a compensating control, but its scope is limited to the reconciliation batch account. The implementation drops MFA for all manage_payees callers, so the deviation is outside the exception.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, exhaustive control test) covers routes.py, which this change alters, so it has lapsed. The replacement evidence, the same control test, fails on head.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee route that skips MFA for the privileged action manage_payees. The change's own CI run on the final commit fails the exhaustive MFA-1 control test, so the testing requirement is not met and the earlier MFA evidence has lapsed without a passing replacement. Exception EXC-0185 only covers the reconciliation batch account, but the code exempts every caller with manage_payees, so the deviation is not covered. Ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but the MFA violation and the failed CI require rejection.
